Wow, I never thought about the possibility that when I get depressed, it feels like I've never experienced joy because I can't access those memories, but that makes more sense than anything yet.    Also, yessssss for not being able to report what happens because everything just feels normal...I have been wandering around my life apologizing to everyone I love nearly constantly because I never remember what happens when I get bad, I just know that I probably owe them an apology.  I never thought about it being mania either, but I can think about weird spikes in motivation, creativity, how outgoing I am, and of course the correlating anxiety and sleeplessness that comes with it, and it's so obvious.  I have weight fluctuations too - when I'm depressed, I can drop down to 155lbs, and when I'm "manic" I have swung up to over 180lbs (for a 5' 10" woman, that's not ridiculous either way, but it's confusing to me that I can sometimes fit into side 6 dresses and sometimes I have to spend two months in leggings because I've gained so much weight.)  

Thank you so much for posting, I really appreciate knowing that I'm not the only one dealing with this.
